title: Antibody design across observed and forecasted antigenic evolution
summary: The Germinal Multi preprint abstract reports antibodies designed against several antigen variants at once. Experimental screens of tens of designs per campaign found binders to resistance-associated EGFR variants and neutralizers of historical SARS-CoV-2 variants, including variants withheld from design. Redesign of BD55-1205 restored neutralization of a forecast-guided engineered escape variant while retaining parental-variant activity. The escape result concerns an engineered variant, not a demonstrated future circulating strain. Review is limited to the abstract and original-server metadata.
ai_technology: Germinal Multi (computational antibody design framework); evolutionary forecasting model

evidence.tested: Tens of designs per campaign were screened experimentally; designs bound EGFR variants and neutralized SARS-CoV-2 variants, including variants withheld from the design process.
evidence.unknown: Review limited to the indexed abstract and publication metadata; full-paper methods and additional limitations were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: Germinal Multi computationally optimized one antibody paratope against multiple antigen variants, and an evolutionary forecasting model guided construction of an escape variant and antibody redesign.
